name: Sweden

pet.recycling_rate: SOURCE: plastic packaging recycled in Sweden: 28.6% in 2023 and 21.8% in 2024 (Eurostat env_waspacr, rates for the 2025 target, table updated 10 November 2026); all plastics together, no separate figure for PET bottles

pet.incineration_share: SOURCE: municipal waste in Sweden in 2024: 2378 kt incinerated with or without energy recovery and 27 kt landfilled, so 99% of what is not recycled is incinerated (Eurostat env_wasmun, table updated 15 October 2026); prior centred at 95%
